movements.notes: same barbell throughout; no re-gripping/dropping between lifts

origin.summary: Workout 4 of the 2021 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A one-rep-max barbell complex — deadlift into clean into hang clean into jerk — performed on the same bar without re-gripping or dropping between lifts.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2021/4 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09; max-load complex -- athlete determines and builds their own barbell load (score is the heaviest complex completed), so there is no prescribed Rx weight; time begins immediately after 21.3
